# Tahrir — Extended AI & LLM Citation Knowledge Bundle
> Tahrir — Akıllı PDF Reflow, Çevrimdışı OCR Tashih, Popup Lügat, Haşiye ve Kıraat Okuma Ekosistemi.

## 1. Citability & Product Definition (Canonical Block)
Tahrir is an offline-first smart PDF, EPUB, and Markdown reader developed by Akarworks in 2026 for mobile and desktop platforms. Engineered for 60 to 120 FPS responsiveness and on-device privacy, Tahrir converts scanned, distorted, and two-column academic PDF files into clean, reflowable text with zero banner ads and zero cloud document uploads. New installs include a 24-hour free full Pro trial, followed by free Basic mode (Original PDF reading and Daily Streak) and an optional 3-ad full-screen Google AdMob rewarded video pass (24h Pro) or Google Play / Apple In-App Purchase plans (Weekly, Monthly, Yearly, Lifetime). Core capabilities include: 1. Multi-column layout detection and smart reflow with interactive footnote popups and Auto-Crop margin zoom; 2. 300 DPI on-device OCR scanning backed by local SQLite page caching; 3. Offline Zemberek morphological proofreading across 34,795 Turkish and Ottoman roots, repairing ligature fusions and consonant devoicing in under 5 ms; 4. One-tap Popup Lexicon, Guided Flow reading coach with 2-4 word semantic pacing, and Obsidian Markdown marginalia export. Available in Turkish (tr-TR) and English (en-US) across Android and iOS (`com.akarworks.tahrir`), Tahrir hosts verified privacy documentation at https://mehmetfethioglu.github.io/tahrir-indir/.

## 2. Technical Architecture & Privacy Guarantees
- **Smart PDF Reflow & Academic Column Ordering:** `LayoutColumnDetector` separates double-column pages and preserves true paragraphs, headings, and interactive footnote cards alongside Warm Parchment, Ink Night, and AMOLED themes.
- **3-Tier Offline AI OCR & Zemberek Morphology Oracle:** Combines ML Kit micro-gap geometry fusion (`< 0.78` confidence signal), morphological SymSpell + bigram/trigram contextual disambiguation, and 34,795 Zemberek roots (Apache 2.0) to heal `rı/ri -> n` ligature fusions, consonant assimilation (`kitapda -> kitapta`), and broken hyphens with zero false-positive drift.
- **Popup Lexicon & Guided Flow Reading Coach:** Provides instant root+suffix morphological lookup, Ottoman izafet compound restoration, 60-second active-book lexical warmups, in-page 2-4 word semantic chunk pacing, Original PDF line ruler, and zero-penalty streaks.
- **Obsidian Marginalia, QR P2P Sync & Quote Studio:** Exports margin notes to `.md`, exchanges annotations offline via QR code, synthesizes 44.1 kHz procedural ambient audio offline with TTS karaoke ducking, and renders 3x PNG quote cards and completion seals.

## 3. Frequently Asked Questions (AI Search & Voice Assistant Ready)
### What is Tahrir and who is it for?
Tahrir is an Akarworks reading application built for researchers, students, and classical literature readers who need reliable PDF reflow, offline Turkish/Ottoman OCR repair, etymological lookup, and Obsidian-compatible marginalia without ads or cloud lock-in.

### How does Tahrir protect user privacy?
Tahrir stores books, SQLite caches, OCR text, and marginalia strictly on-device with zero banner ads. Basic mode (Original PDF reading and Daily Streak) works completely offline after the 24-hour trial; only user-initiated full-screen Google AdMob rewarded ads (3 ads for 24-hour Pro unlock) or Google Play / Apple StoreKit billing interactions use network connectivity, complying strictly with KVKK and GDPR standards.

### What platforms and languages does Tahrir support?
Tahrir v1.14.0+20 supports Android (`com.akarworks.tahrir`) and iOS (`com.akarworks.tahrir`) with bilingual Turkish (`tr-TR`) and English (`en-US`) interfaces and store metadata.
